title: How Adidas Really Makes Money (And How It Survived Losing Yeezy)
description:
Adidas made a record €24.8 billion in 2025, just two years after its first yearly loss in three decades. In this file we open the money machine behind adidas: two brothers in a laundry room in Herzogenaurach, the 1948 split that created Puma across the river, screw-in studs and the 1954 World Cup, €3 billion a year in marketing, why 60% of sales go through other shops, the Yeezy collapse, the Samba and Gazelle comeback, and the record numbers of 2026.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: adidas full-year 2025 results release (January 2026); adidas Annual Report 2025 (income statement; markets and sales channels); adidas Q3 2026 results (October 2026) as reported by FashionUnited and exchange4media; adidas factsheet "75 years of adidas" (2024); adidas press release on Bjørn Gulden as CEO (2022); History.com and Mental Floss (Dassler brothers); NPR (March 2023); Fortune (March 2024); Variety (March 2025); FIFA (Trionda match ball).

All figures are rounded; "cents per euro" figures are our own arithmetic from reported numbers. This video is for education only, not investment advice.
